accepted_gaps.title: Correlation has not been cleanly separated from causal necessity
accepted_gaps.description: Neural activity associated with conscious reports may be a consequence, prerequisite, or companion of experience; perturbational comparisons are needed.

accepted_gaps.title: Report and metacognition contaminate many candidate signatures
accepted_gaps.description: A report requires attention, working memory, decision, motor preparation, and social compliance in addition to experience.

accepted_gaps.title: Competing theories need common, preregistered discriminating predictions
accepted_gaps.description: GNW, IIT, recurrent, higher-order/predictive, and related frameworks can often reinterpret the same result unless predictions are frozen before analysis.

accepted_gaps.title: The spatial and temporal scale of the substrate remains unresolved
accepted_gaps.description: Evidence spans posterior sensory systems, frontoparietal broadcasting, thalamocortical loops, and whole-brain complexity, without a settled causal map.

accepted_gaps.title: Orch-OR lacks a jointly validated bridge from molecular dynamics to experience
accepted_gaps.description: The proposal is conceptually distinct and testable in principle, but decoherence, specificity, and scale-linking remain unresolved.

accepted_gaps.title: State-level consciousness markers do not automatically identify content or mechanism
accepted_gaps.description: Complexity measures can distinguish broad conscious state differences while leaving the location and content-generating mechanism underdetermined.

rejected_or_deferred.claim: Consciousness is simply located in the frontal cortex or posterior cortex.
rejected_or_deferred.reason: The survey supports theory-specific hypotheses, not a settled single-site conclusion.

rejected_or_deferred.claim: A quantum vibration in microtubules proves consciousness is quantum.
rejected_or_deferred.reason: A vibration or coherence observation is not a consciousness-specific causal test.

rejected_or_deferred.claim: A verbal report is identical to conscious experience.
rejected_or_deferred.reason: No-report and control paradigms show the need to separate experience from reporting machinery.
